# BisectionBandwidthMetric

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The minimum bandwidth across any partition of the graph into two equal halves, denoted b(G), measuring the worst-case cut capacity. Critical for assessing the communication bottleneck of a topology under heavy cross-partition traffic, common in distributed inference.
